verdict.rationale: Morph is an API-first service: any OpenAI SDK can call it programmatically with an API key, and its Standby tier is explicitly built for batch and background workloads, so headless automated use is inherent. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI usage specifically, and there is no first-party CLI or pipeline integration. missing for 10: a documented CI/pipeline integration guide, a first-party headless CLI or runner, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1. One API key covers the open-weight chat models and the specialized tools
Built for batch and background workloads where a retry costs nothing.
Create a job, poll until it finishes, then classify text against it.
